This covers both batch imports and interactive CrowdStrike saves. Historical addresses will disappear on each asset’s next import containing IP data; no migration is needed. The behavior is documented in [CROWDSTRIKE_IMPORT.md](/Users/flake/sources/misc/secman/docs/CROWDSTRIKE_IMPORT.md).
